scripts.predev: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 1420 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select -Expand OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; exit 0"
scripts.tauri:debug: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8765,8770 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host '  AVISO: ya hay un backend escuchando en 8765/8770.' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '  Tauri va a REUSARLO en vez de lanzar uno nuevo, asi que OPENCOHOST_DEBUG=1' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '  NO llega al backend y no vas a ver lineas [CLAUSE_SANITIZER].' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '  Cerra ese backend antes de seguir, o confirma managed=true en la UI.' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '' }; exit 0" && set OPENCOHOST_DEBUG=1&& tauri dev
scripts.check:api: node -e "fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8765/openapi.json').then(r=>r.json()).then(j=>require('fs').writeFileSync('openapi.snapshot.check.json',JSON.stringify(j,null,2)+'\n'))" && git diff --no-index --exit-code openapi.snapshot.json openapi.snapshot.check.json && node -e "require('fs').unlinkSync('openapi.snapshot.check.json')"
